verdict.rationale: Postman's Collection Runner and CLI can execute large collections of requests in one run, and the Postman API lets you programmatically manage many Postman assets (collections, environments, mocks) at scale, which together support bulk-style automation; this is corroborated by a hands-on CLI probe showing it runs headlessly. However, there's no explicit documentation or example of 'true' bulk operations (e.g., batch-updating many resources in a single call) — missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch API examples, independent verification of large-scale bulk workflows, and any AI-native framing of bulk operations specifically.
